defs.meaning: 说故事的人；故事作者；短篇小说作家

examples.en: Every storyteller, or, maybe every town, might have had a slightly different version of the same folktale.
examples.zh: 每一个讲故事的人，或者在每一个城镇，关于同一个民间田的版本都可能又细微差别。

examples.en: In the case of folktales, each storyteller would specify a particular location and time, though the time and location would differ for different storytellers.
examples.zh: 在民间故事中，每个讲故事的人都会指定一个特定的地点和时间，尽管时间和地点会因讲故事的人不同而发生改变。

examples.en: His new book shows him to be a first-rate storyteller.
examples.zh: 他的新著表明他讲故事的本领是一流的。
